## Load Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(lmerTest)
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)
library(sandwich)
```

## Load data

```{r data}
# Use the corrected CSVs from the manuscript analyses. Keep the original row order.
paired_path <- "paired_corrected.csv"  # path to dataset
population_path <- "population_corrected.csv"  # path to dataset
sex_audit_path <- "sex_assignment_audit.csv"  # path to dataset
BS <- read.csv(paired_path)
BSpop <- read.csv(population_path)
sex_audit <- read.csv(sex_audit_path)
inferred_ids <- sex_audit$ID[grepl("Inferred opposite role", sex_audit$assignment_source)]
output_dir <- "reviewer_response_results"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(output_dir, "figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)
BS$Species <- factor(BS$Species, levels = c("BCCH", "MOCH"))
BS$Year <- as.integer(BS$Year)
BS$Wing_Difference <- BS$Male.Wing.Chord - BS$Female.Wing.Chord
BSpopI <- BSpop %>%
  arrange(Year, .row) %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("F", "M")), Species = factor(Species, levels = c("BCCH",
    "MOCH")), Bander = factor(Bander))
responses <- c("First.Egg", "Egg_Number", "Nestling_Number", "Avg_Nestling_Weight", "Female_SMI",
  "Male_SMI", "Provisioning")
count_responses <- c("Egg_Number", "Nestling_Number")
wing_center <- mean(BS$Wing_Difference)
BS$x <- BS$Wing_Difference - wing_center
BS$q <- BS$x^2
thresholds <- tapply(BS$Wing_Difference[BS$Wing_Difference > 0], BS$Species[BS$Wing_Difference >
  0], median)
# The median goes in the slightly larger group for MOCH and the much larger group for
# BCCH.
slightly_larger <- with(BS, ifelse(Species == "MOCH", Wing_Difference <= thresholds["MOCH"],
  Wing_Difference < thresholds["BCCH"]))
BS$Wing_Difference_Category <- with(BS, ifelse(Wing_Difference <= 0, NA, ifelse(slightly_larger,
  "Slightly", "Much")))
BS$Elevation_km <- (BS$Elevation - 2000)/1000
```

## Calculate scaled mass index

```{r smi}
# Estimate the SMA exponent and mean wing length separately for each species and sex. Use
# the first complete capture by year, with source order breaking ties.
calibration <- BSpop %>%
  filter(is.finite(Wing.Chord), Wing.Chord > 0, is.finite(Mass), Mass > 0) %>%
  arrange(Year, .row) %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)
smi_parameters <- calibration %>%
  group_by(Species, Sex) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), reference_wing = mean(Wing.Chord), cor_log = cor(log(Mass), log(Wing.Chord)),
    exponent = sign(cor(log(Mass), log(Wing.Chord))) * sd(log(Mass))/sd(log(Wing.Chord)),
    .groups = "drop")
stopifnot(nrow(smi_parameters) == 4, all(is.finite(smi_parameters$exponent)))
for (sex in c("Female", "Male")) {
  parameters <- filter(smi_parameters, Sex == substr(sex, 1, 1))
  i <- match(BS$Species, parameters$Species)
  wing <- BS[[paste0(sex, ".Wing.Chord")]]
  mass <- BS[[paste0(sex, ".Weight")]]
  BS[[paste0(sex, "_SMI")]] <- mass * (parameters$reference_wing[i]/wing)^parameters$exponent[i]
}
write.csv(smi_parameters, file.path(output_dir, "SMI_parameters.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
smi_parameters
```

## Sample sizes and repeated parents and pairs (Table S1)

```{r sampling}
annual <- BS %>%
  count(Year, Species, name = "attempts") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = attempts, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = BCCH + MOCH)
lineage <- BS %>%
  group_by(Location, Species, Year) %>%
  summarise(attempts = n(), pairs = n_distinct(Pair.ID), males = n_distinct(Male.ID), females = n_distinct(Female.ID),
    elevation_mean = mean(Elevation), elevation_min = min(Elevation), elevation_max = max(Elevation),
    .groups = "drop")
sample_rows <- list()
for (y in responses) {
  for (sp in c("BCCH", "MOCH")) {
    ss <- BS[BS$Species == sp & complete.cases(BS[c(y, "Wing_Difference", "Elevation_km",
      "Year")]), ]
    sample_rows[[paste(y, sp)]] <- data.frame(response = y, Species = sp, n = nrow(ss),
      unique_males = n_distinct(ss$Male.ID), unique_females = n_distinct(ss$Female.ID),
      unique_ordered_pairs = n_distinct(ss$Pair.ID), unique_unordered_pairs = n_distinct(ss$.canonical_pair),
      years = paste(sort(unique(ss$Year)), collapse = ", "))
  }
}
samples <- bind_rows(sample_rows)
paired_descriptives <- BS %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(attempts = n(), pairs = n_distinct(Pair.ID), males = n_distinct(Male.ID), females = n_distinct(Female.ID),
    wingdiff_min = min(Wing_Difference), wingdiff_max = max(Wing_Difference), mean_wing = mean(Avg.Wing),
    .groups = "drop")
repeated_pairs <- BS %>%
  count(Species, .canonical_pair, name = "n_attempts") %>%
  filter(n_attempts > 1)
repeated_individuals <- bind_rows(lapply(c("Male", "Female"), function(sex) {
  BS %>%
    group_by(Species, ID = .data[[paste0(sex, ".ID")]]) %>%
    summarise(n_attempts = n(), years = paste(sort(unique(Year)), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n_attempts > 1) %>%
    mutate(Sex = sex)
}))
write.csv(annual, file.path(output_dir, "annual_sampled_attempts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(lineage, file.path(output_dir, "site_year_sample_lineage.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(samples, file.path(output_dir, "analysis_sample_structure.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(paired_descriptives, file.path(output_dir, "paired_descriptives.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(repeated_pairs, file.path(output_dir, "canonical_repeated_pairs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(repeated_individuals, file.path(output_dir, "repeated_individuals.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Wing length differences and mate wing lengths (Table S2)

```{r dimorphism}
mods <- list(population_dimorphism = lmerTest::lmer(Wing.Chord ~ Sex * Species + (1 | Bander),
  BSpopI), pair_dimorphism = lmerTest::lmer(Wing_Difference ~ Species + (1 | Year), BS),
  MOCH_pairing = lmerTest::lmer(Male.Wing.Chord ~ Female.Wing.Chord + (1 | Year), BS[BS$Species ==
    "MOCH", ]), BCCH_pairing = lmerTest::lmer(Male.Wing.Chord ~ Female.Wing.Chord + (1 |
    Year), BS[BS$Species == "BCCH", ]))
cf <- list()
rv <- list()
for (nm in names(mods)) {
  f <- mods[[nm]]
  ct <- coef(summary(f))
  cr <- qt(0.975, ct[, "df"])
  cf[[nm]] <- data.frame(model = nm, n = nobs(f), term = rownames(ct), estimate = ct[, 1],
    SE = ct[, 2], df = ct[, 3], statistic = ct[, 4], p = ct[, 5], CI_low = ct[, 1] - cr *
      ct[, 2], CI_high = ct[, 1] + cr * ct[, 2], row.names = NULL)
  rv[[nm]] <- data.frame(model = nm, as.data.frame(lme4::VarCorr(f)), singular = lme4::isSingular(f))
}
write.csv(bind_rows(cf), file.path(output_dir, "dimorphism_pairing_full_models.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(rv), file.path(output_dir, "dimorphism_pairing_variances.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
summary(mods$population_dimorphism)
summary(mods$pair_dimorphism)
summary(mods$MOCH_pairing)
summary(mods$BCCH_pairing)
# Check the random terms removed from the preliminary SSD models.
preliminary <- list(population_year = lmerTest::lmer(Wing.Chord ~ Sex * Species + (1 | Bander) +
  (1 | Year), BSpopI), pair_banders = lmerTest::lmer(Wing_Difference ~ Species + (1 | Year) +
  (1 | MaleBander) + (1 | FemaleBander), BS))
preliminary_variances <- bind_rows(lapply(names(preliminary), function(nm) {
  data.frame(model = nm, as.data.frame(VarCorr(preliminary[[nm]])), singular = isSingular(preliminary[[nm]]))
}))
write.csv(preliminary_variances, file.path(output_dir, "preliminary_SSD_variances.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
# Sex contrasts for each species, using Satterthwaite degrees of freedom.
contrasts <- list()
for (sp in c("BCCH", "MOCH")) {
  L <- if (sp == "BCCH")
    c(0, 1, 0, 0) else c(0, 1, 0, 1)
  contrasts[[paste(sp, "population")]] <- data.frame(Species = sp, contrast = "population_sex_difference",
    contest1D(mods$population_dimorphism, L, confint = TRUE), check.names = FALSE)
  L <- if (sp == "BCCH")
    c(1, 0) else c(1, 1)
  contrasts[[paste(sp, "pair")]] <- data.frame(Species = sp, contrast = "within_pair_difference",
    contest1D(mods$pair_dimorphism, L, confint = TRUE), check.names = FALSE)
}
sex_contrasts <- bind_rows(contrasts)
population_descriptives <- BSpopI %>%
  group_by(Species, Sex) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean_wing = mean(Wing.Chord), sd_wing = sd(Wing.Chord), .groups = "drop")
pearson <- bind_rows(lapply(c("BCCH", "MOCH"), function(sp) {
  ss <- BS[BS$Species == sp, ]
  cc <- cor.test(ss$Female.Wing.Chord, ss$Male.Wing.Chord)
  data.frame(Species = sp, n = nrow(ss), r = unname(cc$estimate), CI_low = cc$conf.int[1],
    CI_high = cc$conf.int[2], p = cc$p.value)
}))
write.csv(sex_contrasts, file.path(output_dir, "verified_descriptive_contrasts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(population_descriptives, file.path(output_dir, "population_wing_descriptives.csv"),
```

## Does wing length vary with elevation?

```{r elevation}
elevation_models <- list()
elevation_results <- list()
for (sp in c("BCCH", "MOCH")) {
  for (sex in c("F", "M")) {
    ss <- BSpopI[BSpopI$Species == sp & BSpopI$Sex == sex & complete.cases(BSpopI[c("Wing.Chord",
      "Elevation", "Year")]), ]
    ss$Elevation_km <- (ss$Elevation - 2000)/1000
    fit <- lmerTest::lmer(Wing.Chord ~ Elevation_km + (1 | Year), ss)
    cc <- coef(summary(fit))["Elevation_km", ]
    critical <- qt(0.975, cc["df"])
    elevation_models[[paste(sp, sex)]] <- fit
    elevation_results[[paste(sp, sex)]] <- data.frame(Species = sp, Sex = sex, n = nobs(fit),
      estimate = cc[1], SE = cc[2], df = cc[3], statistic = cc[4], p = cc[5], CI_low = cc[1] -
        critical * cc[2], CI_high = cc[1] + critical * cc[2], year_variance = as.data.frame(VarCorr(fit))$vcov[1],
      singular = isSingular(fit))
  }
}
elevation_results <- bind_rows(elevation_results)
write.csv(elevation_results, file.path(output_dir, "elevation_wing_sensitivity.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
elevation_results
```

## Observed and random pairings (Table S15)

```{r random_pairing}
permutation <- list()
permutation_draws <- list()
B <- 10000L
for (sp in c("MOCH", "BCCH")) {
  ss <- BS[BS$Species == sp & complete.cases(BS[c("Male.Wing.Chord", "Female.Wing.Chord")]),
    ]
  delta <- ss$Male.Wing.Chord - ss$Female.Wing.Chord
  threshold <- median(delta[delta > 0])
  set.seed(if (sp == "MOCH")
    26 else 27)
  for (cat in c("Female-larger", "Male-slightly-larger", "Male-much-larger")) {
    s <- if (cat == "Female-larger")
      ss else ss[delta > 0, ]
    wd <- s$Male.Wing.Chord - s$Female.Wing.Chord
    slight <- function(x) if (sp == "MOCH")
      x > 0 & x <= threshold else x > 0 & x < threshold
    much <- function(x) if (sp == "MOCH")
      x > threshold else x >= threshold
    observed <- if (cat == "Female-larger")
      sum(wd < 0) else if (cat == "Male-slightly-larger")
      sum(slight(wd)) else sum(much(wd))
    obs_prop <- observed/nrow(s)
    null <- if (cat == "Male-much-larger")
      1 - null_slight else replicate(B, {
      z <- sample(s$Male.Wing.Chord) - sample(s$Female.Wing.Chord)
      if (cat == "Female-larger")
        mean(z < 0) else if (cat == "Male-slightly-larger")
        sum(slight(z))/sum(z > 0) else sum(much(z))/sum(z > 0)
    })
    if (cat == "Male-slightly-larger")
      null_slight <- null
    permutation_draws[[paste(sp, cat)]] <- data.frame(Species = sp, category = cat, iteration = seq_len(B),
      proportion = null)
    lower <- (1 + sum(null <= obs_prop + 1e-12))/(B + 1)
    upper <- (1 + sum(null >= obs_prop - 1e-12))/(B + 1)
    permutation[[paste(sp, cat)]] <- data.frame(Species = sp, category = cat, threshold,
      observed_n = observed, denominator = nrow(s), observed_prop = obs_prop, null_mean = mean(null),
      null_low = unname(quantile(null, 0.025)), null_high = unname(quantile(null, 0.975)),
      p_lower = lower, p_upper = upper, p_directional = if (cat == "Male-slightly-larger")
        upper else lower, iterations = B)
  }
}
write.csv(bind_rows(permutation_draws), file.path(output_dir, "randomization_draws.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
randomization_results <- bind_rows(permutation)
randomization_results$MC_SE <- with(randomization_results, sqrt(p_directional * (1 - p_directional)/(iterations +
  1)))
null_draws <- bind_rows(permutation_draws)
write.csv(randomization_results, file.path(output_dir, "Table_S15_random_pairing.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
randomization_results
```

## Plot observed and random pairings (Figure 2)

```{r pairing_plot}
species_colors <- c(BCCH = "#0072B2", MOCH = "#CC79A7")
# Figure 2: observed wing differences and random pairings.
dens <- list()
histograms <- list()
for (sp in c("MOCH", "BCCH")) {
  dd <- BS[BS$Species == sp, ]
  cut <- thresholds[[sp]]
  ymax <- max(density(dd$Wing_Difference)$y) * 1.05
  dens[[sp]] <- ggplot(dd, aes(Wing_Difference)) + geom_density(fill = species_colors[sp],
    alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.3) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) + geom_vline(xintercept = cut,
    linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) + annotate("text", x = -2.4, y = ymax * 0.5,
    label = "Female larger", size = 3.4) + annotate("text", x = cut/2, y = ymax * 0.5,
    label = "Male slightly\nlarger", size = 3.4) + annotate("text", x = cut + 2.1, y = ymax *
    0.5, label = "Male much\nlarger", size = 3.4) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-7, 12.2),
    breaks = seq(-6, 12, 2), expand = expansion(mult = 0)) + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-7,
    12.2), ylim = c(0, ymax), expand = FALSE) + theme_classic(base_size = 10) + theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black",
    fill = NA, linewidth = 0.35), axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"), plot.margin = margin(2,
    5, 2, 2)) + labs(x = if (sp == "BCCH")
    "Difference Between Male and Female Wing Chord (mm)" else NULL, y = "Density")
  for (cat in c("Female-larger", "Male-slightly-larger", "Male-much-larger")) {
    nn <- null_draws[null_draws$Species == sp & null_draws$category == cat, ]
    tt <- randomization_results[randomization_results$Species == sp & randomization_results$category ==
      cat, ]
    obs <- 100 * tt$observed_prop
    label <- switch(cat, `Female-larger` = "Percent female larger\npairings", `Male-slightly-larger` = "Percent male slightly\nlarger pairings",
      `Male-much-larger` = "Percent male much\nlarger pairings")
    pp <- ggplot(nn, aes(proportion * 100)) + geom_histogram(bins = 10, fill = species_colors[sp],
      color = "black", alpha = if (sp == "BCCH")
        0.8 else 1, linewidth = 0.3) + geom_vline(xintercept = obs, color = "black", linewidth = 1.8) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = obs, color = "#ADD8E6", linewidth = 1) + theme_cowplot() +
      labs(x = if (sp == "BCCH")
        label else NULL, y = "Count") + theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 10), axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      plot.margin = margin(3, 7, 3, 3))
    sig <- if (tt$p_directional < 0.001)
      "***" else if (tt$p_directional < 0.01)
      "**" else if (tt$p_directional < 0.05)
      "*" else ""
    if (nchar(sig))
      pp <- pp + annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = sig, hjust = 1.8, vjust = 1.1,
        size = 8)
    histograms[[paste(sp, cat)]] <- pp
  }
}
```

## Functions for the reproductive models

```{r model_functions}
# Joint tests use both wing difference terms from the same model.  BCCH is the reference
# species. For MOCH, add the interaction to each main term.
coefficient_table <- function(f) {
  if (inherits(f, "glmmTMB")) {
    c <- coef(summary(f))$cond
    df <- rep(Inf, nrow(c))
  } else if (inherits(f, "merMod")) {
    c <- coef(summary(f))
    df <- c[, "df"]
  } else {
    c <- coef(summary(f))
    df <- rep(df.residual(f), nrow(c))
  }
  crit <- qt(0.975, df)
  data.frame(term = rownames(c), estimate = c[, 1], SE = c[, 2], CI_low = c[, 1] - crit *
    c[, 2], CI_high = c[, 1] + crit * c[, 2], statistic = c[, if (inherits(f, "merMod"))
    "t value" else 3], df = df, p = c[, ncol(c)], row.names = NULL)
}
fixed_estimates <- function(f) if (inherits(f, "glmmTMB")) fixef(f)$cond else if (inherits(f,
  "merMod")) fixef(f) else coef(f)
fixed_covariance <- function(f) if (inherits(f, "glmmTMB")) as.matrix(vcov(f)$cond) else as.matrix(vcov(f))
joint_test <- function(f, L, V = NULL) {
  b <- fixed_estimates(f)
  L <- as.matrix(L)
  L <- L[, names(b), drop = FALSE]
  if (is.null(V))
    V <- fixed_covariance(f)
  est <- as.numeric(L %*% b)
  cv <- L %*% V %*% t(L)
  r <- qr(L)$rank
  W <- as.numeric(t(est) %*% solve(cv, est))
  if (inherits(f, "merMod")) {
    c <- lmerTest::contestMD(f, L, ddf = "Satterthwaite")
    return(data.frame(test = "F Satterthwaite", statistic = c[["F value"]], df1 = c[["NumDF"]],
      df2 = c[["DenDF"]], p = c[["Pr(>F)"]]))
  }
  if (inherits(f, "lm"))
    return(data.frame(test = "F", statistic = W/r, df1 = r, df2 = df.residual(f), p = pf(W/r,
      r, df.residual(f), lower.tail = FALSE)))
  data.frame(test = "Wald chi-square", statistic = W, df1 = r, df2 = NA_real_, p = pchisq(W,
    r, lower.tail = FALSE))
}
test_contrast <- function(f, target, category = FALSE) {
  b <- fixed_estimates(f)
  z <- matrix(0, nrow = if (category)
    1 else 2, ncol = length(b), dimnames = list(NULL, names(b)))
  a <- if (category)
    "categorySlightly" else c("x", "q")
  inter <- vapply(a, function(t) {
    v <- c(paste0(t, ":SpeciesMOCH"), paste0("SpeciesMOCH:", t))
    v[v %in% names(b)][1]
  }, character(1))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(inter))
  if (target == "species_difference")
    for (i in seq_along(a)) z[i, inter[i]] <- 1
  if (target %in% c("BCCH_association", "MOCH_association")) {
    for (i in seq_along(a)) z[i, a[i]] <- 1
    if (target == "MOCH_association")
      for (i in seq_along(a)) z[i, inter[i]] <- 1
  }
  if (target == "curvature") {
    z[, ] <- 0
    z[1, "q"] <- 1
    z[2, inter[2]] <- 1
  }
  z
}
model_tests <- function(f, y, scheme = "all_attempts", category = FALSE) {
  targets <- if (category)
    c("species_difference", "BCCH_association", "MOCH_association") else c("species_difference", "BCCH_association", "MOCH_association", "curvature")
  bind_rows(lapply(targets, function(t) cbind(data.frame(response = y, scheme = scheme, target = t,
    n = nobs(f)), joint_test(f, test_contrast(f, t, category)))))
}
adjust_p_values <- function(d) d %>%
  group_by(scheme, target) %>%
  mutate(BH_p = p.adjust(p, "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()
fit_reproductive_model <- function(y, d, random_year = FALSE, category = FALSE, extra = "") {
  rhs <- if (category)
    "category * Species" else "(x + q) * Species"
  rhs <- paste(rhs, "+ Elevation_km +", if (random_year)
    "(1 | Year)" else "factor(Year)", extra)
  fm <- as.formula(paste(y, "~", rhs))
  if (y %in% count_responses) {
    f <- glmmTMB(fm, data = d, family = compois(link = "log"), dispformula = if (y == "Egg_Number")
      ~Species else ~1, control = glmmTMBControl(optCtrl = list(iter.max = 10000, eval.max = 10000)))
    stopifnot(f$fit$convergence == 0, isTRUE(f$sdr$pdHess))
  } else if (random_year)
    f <- lmerTest::lmer(fm, data = d, REML = FALSE) else f <- lm(fm, data = d)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(fixed_estimates(f)))
  f
}
select_attempts <- function(d, scheme) {
  d <- d[order(d$Year, d$.row), ]
  if (scheme == "first_pair")
    d <- d[!duplicated(d$.canonical_pair), ]
  if (scheme == "first_male")
    d <- d[!duplicated(d$Male.ID), ]
  if (scheme == "first_female")
    d <- d[!duplicated(d$Female.ID), ]
  if (scheme == "exclude_inferred_roles")
    d <- d[!d$Male.ID %in% inferred_ids & !d$Female.ID %in% inferred_ids, ]
  if (scheme == "no_shared_parent") {
    used <- character()
    keep <- logical(nrow(d))
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(d))) {
      ids <- c(d$Male.ID[i], d$Female.ID[i])
      if (!any(ids %in% used)) {
        keep[i] <- TRUE
        used <- c(used, ids)
      }
    }
    d <- d[keep, ]
    stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(c(d$Male.ID, d$Female.ID)))
  }
  d
}
```

```{r reproduction}
  members[[y]] <- cbind(data.frame(response = y), d[c(".row", "Year", "Species", "Nestbox",
    "Male.ID", "Female.ID", "Pair.ID")])
}
```

## Repeated parents and year (Table S10)

```{r sensitivity}
sensitivity <- list()
sens_tests <- list()
sens_meta <- list()
sens_members <- list()
for (y in responses) {
  eligible <- BS[complete.cases(BS[c(y, "x", "q", "Species", "Elevation_km", "Year")]), ]
  for (scheme in c("first_pair", "first_male", "first_female", "no_shared_parent", "exclude_inferred_roles",
    "random_year")) {
    d <- select_attempts(eligible, scheme)
    f <- fit_reproductive_model(y, d, random_year = scheme == "random_year")
    key <- paste(y, scheme, sep = "|")
    sensitivity[[key]] <- f
    sens_tests[[key]] <- model_tests(f, y, scheme)
    sens_members[[key]] <- cbind(data.frame(response = y, scheme = scheme), d[c(".row",
      "Year", "Species", "Nestbox", "Male.ID", "Female.ID", "Pair.ID")])
    yrvar <- if (scheme != "random_year")
      NA_real_ else if (inherits(f, "glmmTMB"))
      as.numeric(VarCorr(f)$cond$Year[1]) else as.data.frame(VarCorr(f))$vcov[1]
    sens_meta[[key]] <- data.frame(response = y, scheme = scheme, n = nobs(f), year_variance = yrvar,
      boundary = if (is.na(yrvar))
        NA else yrvar < 1e-08)
  }
}
sensitivity_tests <- adjust_p_values(bind_rows(sens_tests))
write.csv(sensitivity_tests, file.path(output_dir, "Table_S10_identity_and_year_joint_tests.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(sens_meta), file.path(output_dir, "sensitivity_model_metadata.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(sens_members), file.path(output_dir, "sensitivity_retained_attempts.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE)
```

## Slightly and much larger males (Table S11)

```{r categories}
categories <- list()
category_tests <- list()
category_coefs <- list()
category_contrasts <- list()
for (y in responses) {
  d <- BS[BS$Wing_Difference > 0 & complete.cases(BS[c(y, "Wing_Difference", "Species", "Elevation_km",
    "Year")]), ]
  d$category <- factor(d$Wing_Difference_Category, levels = c("Much", "Slightly"))
  f <- fit_reproductive_model(y, d, category = TRUE)
  categories[[y]] <- f
  category_tests[[y]] <- model_tests(f, y, category = TRUE)
  category_coefs[[y]] <- cbind(data.frame(response = y), coefficient_table(f))
  for (sp in c("BCCH", "MOCH")) {
    L <- test_contrast(f, paste0(sp, "_association"), category = TRUE)
    b <- fixed_estimates(f)
    est <- as.numeric(L %*% b)
    se <- sqrt(as.numeric(L %*% fixed_covariance(f) %*% t(L)))
    df <- if (inherits(f, "lm"))
      df.residual(f) else Inf
    category_contrasts[[paste(y, sp)]] <- data.frame(response = y, Species = sp, n = nobs(f),
      estimate = est, SE = se, CI_low = est - qt(0.975, df) * se, CI_high = est + qt(0.975,
        df) * se)
  }
}
category_tests <- adjust_p_values(bind_rows(category_tests))
write.csv(category_tests, file.path(output_dir, "Table_S11_categorical_joint_tests.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(category_coefs), file.path(output_dir, "categorical_full_coefficients.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(category_contrasts), file.path(output_dir, "categorical_derived_species_contrasts.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE)
category_tests
```

## Parental mass at a given wing length (Table S14)

```{r parent_mass}
mass_models <- list()
mass_tests <- list()
mass_coefs <- list()
for (sex in c("Female", "Male")) {
  d <- BS
  d$Mass <- d[[paste0(sex, ".Weight")]]
  d$OwnWing <- d[[paste0(sex, ".Wing.Chord")]]
  d <- d[complete.cases(d[c("Mass", "OwnWing", "x", "q", "Species", "Elevation_km", "Year")]) &
    d$Mass > 0 & d$OwnWing > 0, ]
  d$logMass <- log(d$Mass)
  d$logWing <- log(d$OwnWing)
  for (scheme in c("all_attempts", "no_shared_parent")) {
    dd <- select_attempts(d, scheme)
    f <- lm(logMass ~ (x + q) * Species + logWing * Species + Elevation_km + factor(Year),
      dd)
    key <- paste(sex, scheme, sep = "|")
    mass_models[[key]] <- f
    mass_coefs[[key]] <- cbind(data.frame(parent = sex, scheme = scheme), coefficient_table(f))
    for (covariance in c("model", "HC3")) for (target in c("species_difference", "BCCH_association",
      "MOCH_association", "curvature")) {
      V <- if (covariance == "HC3")
        sandwich::vcovHC(f, type = "HC3") else vcov(f)
      mass_tests[[paste(key, covariance, target)]] <- cbind(data.frame(parent = sex,
        scheme = scheme, covariance = covariance, target = target, n = nobs(f)), joint_test(f,
        test_contrast(f, target), V))
    }
  }
}
mass_tests <- bind_rows(mass_tests) %>%
  group_by(scheme, covariance, target) %>%
  mutate(BH_p_two_sexes = p.adjust(p, "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()
write.csv(mass_tests, file.path(output_dir, "Table_S14_conditional_mass_joint_tests.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(mass_coefs), file.path(output_dir, "conditional_mass_full_coefficients.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE)
mass_tests
```

## Predicted reproductive outcomes (Figure 3)

```{r predictions}
predict_response <- function(f, grid) {
  grid$x <- grid$Wing_Difference - wing_center
  grid$q <- grid$x^2
  pred <- predict(f, newdata = grid, se.fit = TRUE, type = if (inherits(f, "glmmTMB"))
    "link" else "response")
  crit <- if (inherits(f, "lm"))
    qt(0.975, df.residual(f)) else qnorm(0.975)
  grid$predicted <- as.numeric(pred$fit)
  grid$CI_low <- grid$predicted - crit * as.numeric(pred$se.fit)
  grid$CI_high <- grid$predicted + crit * as.numeric(pred$se.fit)
  if (inherits(f, "glmmTMB"))
    grid[c("predicted", "CI_low", "CI_high")] <- lapply(grid[c("predicted", "CI_low", "CI_high")],
      exp)
  grid
}
prediction_rows <- list()
endpoints <- list()
plots <- list()
ylabs <- c("First-egg date (day of year)", "Clutch size", "Brood size at day 12", "Average nestling mass (g)",
  "Female SMI (g)", "Male SMI (g)", "Provisioning rate (visits/h)")
for (i in seq_along(responses)) {
  y <- responses[i]
  d <- BS[complete.cases(BS[c(y, "x", "q", "Species", "Elevation_km", "Year")]), ]
  f <- primary[[y]]
  for (sp in c("BCCH", "MOCH")) {
    rg <- range(d$Wing_Difference[d$Species == sp])
    g <- data.frame(Wing_Difference = seq(rg[1], rg[2], length.out = 201), Species = factor(sp,
      levels = c("BCCH", "MOCH")), Elevation_km = median(d$Elevation_km), Year = 2024)
    pr <- predict_response(f, g)
    pr$response <- y
    prediction_rows[[paste(y, sp)]] <- pr
    ep <- pr[c(1, nrow(pr)), ]
    ep$endpoint <- c("minimum", "maximum")
    endpoints[[paste(y, sp)]] <- ep
  }
  preds <- bind_rows(prediction_rows)[bind_rows(prediction_rows)$response == y, ]
  plots[[y]] <- ggplot(d, aes(Wing_Difference, .data[[y]], color = Species)) + geom_point(size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.65) + geom_ribbon(data = preds, aes(y = NULL, ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high,
    fill = Species), color = NA, alpha = 0.14) + geom_line(data = preds, aes(y = predicted),
    linewidth = 0.8) + scale_color_manual(values = c(BCCH = "#0072B2", MOCH = "#CC79A7")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(BCCH = "#0072B2", MOCH = "#CC79A7")) + labs(x = "Male-minus-female wing length (mm)",
    y = ylabs[i]) + theme_classic(base_size = 10) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
predictions <- bind_rows(prediction_rows)
write.csv(predictions, file.path(output_dir, "pooled_quadratic_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(endpoints), file.path(output_dir, "prediction_endpoints.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
key_data <- data.frame(Species = c("BCCH", "MOCH"), y = c(0.64, 0.36))
key <- ggplot(key_data, aes(y = y)) + geom_segment(aes(x = 0.1, xend = 0.37, yend = y, color = Species),
  linewidth = 1.6) + geom_point(aes(x = 0.235, fill = Species), shape = 21, color = "black",
  size = 4.3, stroke = 0.35) + geom_text(aes(x = 0.45, label = Species), hjust = 0, size = 6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = species_colors) + scale_fill_manual(values = species_colors) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), expand = FALSE) + theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "none")
figure <- wrap_plots(c(plots, list(wrap_elements(full = key, ignore_tag = TRUE))), ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "figures/Figure_3_pooled_quadratic.png"), figure, width = 9, height = 11,
```

## Model diagnostics and collinearity (Table S13)

```{r diagnostics}
diag <- list()
pdf(file.path(output_dir, "primary_model_residual_plots.pdf"), width = 8, height = 7)
for (i in seq_along(responses)) {
  y <- responses[i]
  f <- primary[[y]]
  if (y %in% count_responses) {
    sim <- simulateResiduals(f, n = 2000, seed = 8110 + i, plot = FALSE)
    plot(sim)
    diag[[y]] <- data.frame(response = y, n = nobs(f), convergence = f$fit$convergence,
      PD_Hessian = f$sdr$pdHess, uniformity_p = testUniformity(sim, plot = FALSE)$p.value,
      dispersion_p = testDispersion(sim, plot = FALSE)$p.value, outlier_p = testOutliers(sim,
        plot = FALSE, type = "bootstrap")$p.value)
  } else {
    par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
    plot(f)
    par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
    diag[[y]] <- data.frame(response = y, n = nobs(f), residual_SD = sigma(f), rank = f$rank)
  }
}
dev.off()
write.csv(bind_rows(diag), file.path(output_dir, "Table_S13_primary_diagnostics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
vifs <- list()
gvifs <- list()
for (y in names(primary)) {
  f <- primary[[y]]
  X <- model.matrix(f)
  assignment <- attr(X, "assign")
  XX <- X[, colnames(X) != "(Intercept)", drop = FALSE]
  v <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(XX)), function(j) 1/(1 - summary(lm(XX[, j] ~ XX[, -j, drop = FALSE]))$r.squared))
  vifs[[y]] <- data.frame(response = y, column = colnames(XX), VIF = v)
  V <- fixed_covariance(f)
  R <- cov2cor(V[rownames(V) != "(Intercept)", colnames(V) != "(Intercept)", drop = FALSE])
  aa <- assignment[assignment != 0]
  labels <- attr(terms(formula(f)), "term.labels")
  gvifs[[y]] <- bind_rows(lapply(sort(unique(aa)), function(a) {
    idx <- which(aa == a)
    other <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(R)), idx)
    g <- det(R[idx, idx, drop = FALSE]) * det(R[other, other, drop = FALSE])/det(R)
    data.frame(response = y, term = labels[a], df = length(idx), GVIF = g, adjusted_GVIF = g^(1/(2 *
      length(idx))))
  }))
}
write.csv(bind_rows(vifs), file.path(output_dir, "full_design_VIF.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(gvifs), file.path(output_dir, "term_GVIF.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(output_dir, "session_info.txt"))
bind_rows(diag)
```
